turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You entered a zero before anyone called me, Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so tell me who decided it and on what basis.
Don't thank me. On what basis did Owen get a zero?
You haven't answered me yet. Who entered that zero, and on what basis?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Subject: Owen Kalinowski, English 30-1 essay zero
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,
We met today, Tuesday, November 10, at 4:15. Nothing was agreed.
I asked who entered Owen's zero and on what basis, and I did not get an answer.
I want the zero withdrawn, written confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record, and an explanation of why procedure 4.2 was not followed before the mark was entered.
I expect your written reply by end of day Thursday, November 12. If I don't receive it, I'll ask the principal to review the decision under procedure 4.6.
Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreed to nothing.
Moved at: none
Slipped at: none
